writing_coach.name: Writing Coach
writing_coach.tagline: Write business emails like a native
writing_coach.value_prop: AI-powered writing assistant — checks your writing in real time, provides suggestions for tone, grammar, and business English fit.
how_to: Start writing an email or business document
AI coach sends real-time grammar and tone suggestions
Accept or reject suggestions — the final text is yours
writing_coach.first_action: Try writing a simple thank-you email

pronunciation_coach.name: Pronunciation Coach
pronunciation_coach.value_prop: Listens to your speech via microphone, provides visual + audio feedback for correct pronunciation.
how_to: Select a word or phrase
Speak into the microphone
AI coach compares pronunciation and gives you a score
pronunciation_coach.target_level: All levels from A1 and above
pronunciation_coach.first_action: Start with the word 'Hello' — the easiest!

grammar_coach.name: Grammar Coach
grammar_coach.tagline: Learn grammar rules with Turkish explanations
grammar_coach.value_prop: Every topic explained in Turkish, examples in English. Practice exercises to reinforce immediately.
how_to: Pick a topic matching your level
Read the Turkish explanation, review examples
Test yourself with short exercises
grammar_coach.target_level: All levels from A1 to B2

vocab_game.name: Vocab Game
vocab_game.tagline: Learn business English words with gamification
vocab_game.value_prop: Custom vocabulary cards for each level. Visuals + Turkish translation + pronunciation + example sentence.
how_to: Pick your level
Flip cards and guess the meaning
Collect points, master through repetition
vocab_game.target_level: All levels from A1 to C1
vocab_game.first_action: Play a quick round with 10 words

simulation_mode.name: Business Scenarios
simulation_mode.tagline: Learn by living real business situations
simulation_mode.value_prop: Role-play real business scenarios like meetings, emails, sales calls with AI. Develops both speaking and writing skills.
how_to: Select a role suitable for the scenario (sales rep, HR specialist, etc.)
Dialogue with AI
Get feedback about your performance
simulation_mode.target_level: A2 and above — ideal for B1+

interview_sim.name: Interview Simulator
interview_sim.value_prop: Practice answering industry-specific interview questions. Feedback on tone, fluency, and content.
how_to: Pick your industry (tech, finance, manufacturing, etc.)
Have a dialogue with the AI interviewer
Get a report on your strengths and weaknesses
interview_sim.first_action: Start with a 'Tell me about yourself' question

presentation_sim.name: Presentation Simulator
presentation_sim.tagline: Gain fluency and impact in English presentations
presentation_sim.value_prop: Pick a topic, AI gives you a presentation structure + tips. Live rehearsal with feedback on tone and timing.
how_to: Choose or create your presentation topic
Start rehearsing with AI
Get a report on tone, timing, fluency

ai_quiz.name: Smart Quiz
ai_quiz.tagline: Personal quizzes adapted to your level
ai_quiz.value_prop: Each question's difficulty is auto-adjusted based on your answers. Focuses on your weak areas.
how_to: Choose a topic or mixed mode
Answer questions
AI picks the next question based on your performance
ai_quiz.target_level: All levels from A1 to C2

ai_tutor.name: Personal Tutor
ai_tutor.tagline: AI teacher you can ask everything in Turkish
ai_tutor.value_prop: Ask anything about English in Turkish — AI answers in Turkish. Perfect for A1.
how_to: Type your question in Turkish: 'When is present perfect used?'
AI provides Turkish explanation + English examples
Go deeper with follow-up questions
ai_tutor.target_level: All levels from A1 to C2 — Turkish support especially helpful for A1-A2
ai_tutor.first_action: Ask 'How do I start a business email?'

learning_path.name: Learning Path
learning_path.tagline: Your personal learning route — step by step
learning_path.value_prop: A gradual roadmap from your level to your goal. New topic each week, measurable progress.
how_to: Select your goal (interview, presentation, meeting, etc.)
See your roadmap
Complete one step each week
learning_path.target_level: All levels from A1 and above
learning_path.first_action: Choose your goal to create your roadmap

level_exams.name: Level Exams
level_exams.tagline: Move up to the next CEFR level

Take the exam
On success, access upper level content
level_exams.target_level: All levels from A1 to C2

materials.name: Materials
materials.tagline: E-books, audio, documents from the library
materials.value_prop: Oxford-referenced business English materials, PDFs, audio files — all downloadable for offline use.

Read online or download
Go at your own pace

Sign up
Join the live Zoom session

Click Join
